issue_request: FHIR-16990 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Element page request to stop using an element named code for a Coding XML/JSON representation sample, because that confused element names with the primitive code datatype.
initial_application: Jira records svn 14305. The git mirror commit 3f47c0507c60e581b62ea07dfa0fe31add7539b4 (GF#16990 - clarify language) changed the source/element.html Coding examples from code to use and changed the primitive examples to a code-valued status element/property.
additional_context: The historical source/element.html content moved into source/types.html during the abstract type framework rebuild in cbdf7d1e55, preserving the corrected example names. FHIR-18414 later removed the entire XML/JSON Representation of Elements section as redundant with the syntax pages, via commit 7c6b930880820a97fb1515a3ec096dfc24130a7e. Element remains active in source/fhir.ini as an abstract infrastructure type, and current source/types.html no longer contains the confusing sample.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current build-scope source does not require any source edit for FHIR-16990.
